lines.text: 1. What exactly makes ITC's approach "alternative" for adenocarcinoma?

lines.text: Unlike standard protocols that focus solely on killing cells through toxicity, ITC uses Alternative Adenocarcinoma Cancer Treatment in Tijuana Mexico to strengthen the body's natural defenses. lines.text: 2. Can ITC treat adenocarcinoma that has metastasized?

lines.text: 3. Is the Out-Patient program safe for someone with low energy?

lines.text: 4. Are the tumor markers checked specifically for glandular cancers?
